```{r setup, include=FALSE}
# Hide code, messages, and warnings in the final Word document
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)

# Load packages
library(tidyverse)   
library(lubridate)
library(NatParksPalettes) 
acadia <- natparks.pals("Acadia")
```

```{r function}
# process_air_data()
# Function Purpose: 
  # Read in and clean one year of EPA air quality data from 
  #the RDU airport monitor

# Each Argument:
  # file_path = file path to each year's CSV file
  # o3_units = the units for ozone levels either ppm or ppb

# Function Returns:
  # a data frame with:
  # row = each day
  # columns = date, co, pm25, o3

clean_data <- function(file_path, o3_units = "ppm") {

# Check that o3_units is a valid option
  
  if (!(o3_units %in% c("ppm", "ppb"))) {
    stop("o3_units must be either 'ppm' or 'ppb'")
  }

# Read in the data
  
dat <- read.csv(file_path)

# Keep the date and the 3 pollutant columns (no units columns needed)

dat <- dat[, c(1, 2, 4, 6)]
names(dat) <- c("date", "co", "pm25", "o3")

# Format the date variable

dat$date <- as.Date(dat$date, format = "%m/%d/%Y")

# Remove duplicate rows 

dat <- unique(dat)

# Set negative values to 0

  for (i in 2:ncol(dat)) {
    dat[!is.na(dat[, i]) & dat[, i] < 0, i] <- 0
  }

# Calculate the daily average for days with multiple measurements 

dat <- dat %>%
    group_by(date) %>%
    summarize(
      co   = ifelse(all(is.na(co)),   NA, mean(co,   na.rm = TRUE)),
      pm25 = ifelse(all(is.na(pm25)), NA, mean(pm25, na.rm = TRUE)),
      o3   = ifelse(all(is.na(o3)),   NA, mean(o3,   na.rm = TRUE))
    )


# Convert ozone to ppb if requested

  if (o3_units == "ppb") {
    dat$o3 <- dat$o3 * 1000
  }

  return(dat)
}
```

```{r combine}
# Run the function on each year and combine them into one dataset

aq18 <- clean_data(file_path = "data/AQ_2018.csv")
aq18$year <- 2018

aq19 <- clean_data(file_path = "data/AQ_2019.csv")
aq19$year <- 2019

aq20 <- clean_data(file_path = "data/AQ_2020.csv")
aq20$year <- 2020

# Stack the three years into one dataset
air_quality <- rbind(aq18, aq19, aq20)
```


## Plots

```{r plot1, fig.width = 7, fig.height = 6}
# Add a month variable

air_quality$month <- factor(format(air_quality$date, "%b"), levels = month.abb)

# Monthly mean and 95% CI for CO

co_month <- air_quality %>%
  filter(!is.na(co)) %>%                     
  group_by(month) %>%                   
  summarize(avg = mean(co), s = sd(co), n = n()) %>%
  mutate(LB = avg - 1.96 * s / sqrt(n),
         UB = avg + 1.96 * s / sqrt(n),
         pollutant = "CO (ppm)")

# Monthly mean and 95% CI for o3

o3_month <- air_quality %>%
  filter(!is.na(o3)) %>%
  group_by(month) %>%
  summarize(avg = mean(o3), s = sd(o3), n = n()) %>%
  mutate(LB = avg - 1.96 * s / sqrt(n),
         UB = avg + 1.96 * s / sqrt(n),
         pollutant = "O3 (ppm)")

# Stack CO and o3 together

plot1_data <- rbind(co_month, o3_month)

# Plot: points = monthly mean, error bars = 95% CI

ggplot(plot1_data, aes(x = month, y = avg, color = pollutant)) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = LB, ymax = UB), width = 0.3) +
  facet_wrap(~ pollutant, ncol = 1, scales = "free_y") +
    scale_color_manual(name = "Pollutant", values = c(acadia[1], acadia[8])) + 
  xlab("Month") +
  ylab("Mean daily concentration (95% CI)") +
  ggtitle("Monthly Mean CO and O3 Concentrations, RDU Airport, 2018–2020") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
```

```{r plot2-ci, fig.width = 8, fig.height = 5}
# Monthly mean and 95% CI of PM2.5 for each year

plot2_data <- air_quality %>%
  filter(!is.na(pm25)) %>%
  group_by(year, month) %>%
  summarize(avg = mean(pm25), s = sd(pm25), n = n()) %>%
  mutate(LB = avg - 1.96 * s / sqrt(n),
         UB = avg + 1.96 * s / sqrt(n))

# Make the plot

ggplot(plot2_data, aes(x = month, y = avg, color = factor(year))) +
  geom_point(size = 2.5, position = position_dodge(width = 0.5)) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = LB, ymax = UB), width = 0.3, position = position_dodge(width = 0.5)) +
  scale_color_manual(name = "Year", values = c(acadia[2], acadia[7], acadia[9])) +
  xlab("Month") +
  ylab("Mean daily PM2.5 concentration (µg/m³), 95% CI") +
  ggtitle("Monthly Mean PM2.5 by Year, RDU Airport, 2018–2020") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
```

## Plot 2 Justification

I chose to do a plot with monthly means of pm2.5 and 95% confidence intervals (with one point per year for each month) because the plot looked neat and easy to read, showed the uncertainty of each month's estimate as well as the variability between months, and because it matched the style of Plot 1 which made the overall report look professional.  

## Interpretation

CO is highest in late fall and winter (October - January) and lowest in summer, while o3 peaks in late spring and summer (April - July) and is lowest in late fall and winter (November - January). Since 2020 data stop in April, estimates for May–December are based on only two years of data and should be interpreted with more caution because with a smaller sample size the estimate will be less precise and one unusual year could have more of an effect.  

PM2.5 shows no strong seasonal pattern; however, January–February 2020 had lower PM2.5 than the same months in 2018 and 2019.
